title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics, parity fixes, bump v1.110.0
description: Motivation: Bring Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs to parity for auth and retry behavior, improve streaming ergonomics (backpressure and cancellation semantics), and publish a coordinated version bump to v1.110.0. This PR combines small breaking ergonomics improvements (documented below) with parity fixes discovered during cross-language QA and a handful of performance tweaks to streaming clients. Changes include: unified auth token refresh + retry policy across SDKs, consistent streaming event types and close semantics, new convenience helpers for common patterns, and version/versioned changelog updates. Checklist: - [x] Specified Linear tasks ENG-4821, ENG-4822 - [x] Unit + integration tests updated - [x] Release notes drafted - [x] Changelog/version bump applied Non-goals: no changes to server API surface or breaking wire protocol updates. Testing and rollout: this landed as a canary in internal beta, smoke tested with Redwood Console, and then promoted. Backwards compatibility: token refresh defaults preserve previous behavior unless user opts into aggressive refresh via new options documented in SDK CHANGELOG. See comments below for rationale on some ergonomics decisions.
author: Priya Malhotra
commits: python: unify auth token refresh + add exponential_backoff retry policy (c14f2d3)
typescript: streaming client: add backpressure hooks and deterministic close events (a9b3f11)
go: ergonomics: introduce ClientOptions builder + simplify streaming iterator (d2e8b77)
sdks: integration tests for cross-language parity on retry/auth (f4c9a0b)
chore: bump SDK versions to v1.110.0 and update changelogs (e7a1c23)
review_comments: Ethan Zhang (2026-02-19): Left a few nits on python client naming and asked for an explicit note about backward compatibility for token refresh. Response: updated docs and added a compatibility flag in ClientOptions.

Marina Lopez (2026-02-20): Requested additional tests around cancellation semantics for TypeScript streaming client. Response: added two unit tests and an integration test that exercises client.cancel() during active stream.
Carlos Gutierrez (2026-02-21): Noted a potential race in Go streaming iterator close path. Response: fixed by serializing close path and added a reproducer test; CI now green.
Ethan Zhang (2026-02-22): Approve after tests pass and minor doc tweaks.
ci_checks: integration: initially failing (streaming race), rerun -> pass
release_notes:
- sdks: unify auth token refresh and retry policy across Python/TS/Go; improved defaults for transient errors
- streaming: add backpressure hooks, deterministic close events, and cancellation semantics parity across SDKs
- ergonomics: ClientOptions builder in Go and convenience helpers in Python/TS
- tests: cross-language parity tests and integration CI improvements
- version: bump SDKs to v1.110.0
